# FANPLAY Dust wgpu-2d fork

This is Dust `76d79f25e4ea3ce355c4ac868f5ac9a233e64b89`'s `render/wgpu-2d`
crate. FANPLAY carries the source locally so it can expose readback for its
process-separated `VideoSink` contract while using Dust's wgpu 2D/3D renderer.
Keep changes minimal and compare updates against the upstream revision.

Upstream: https://github.com/kelpsyberry/dust/tree/76d79f25e4ea3ce355c4ac868f5ac9a233e64b89/render/wgpu-2d
